name: Nathaniel Price
bio: A veteran esports-business journalist in his forties, known for a sustained editorial line arguing that private-technology capital is reshaping competitive gaming to the disadvantage of traditional organizations. Interviewed Adrian Vale directly at the Kairos campus on 2027-01-14 after publishing seven consecutive articles critical of Asterion Intelligence's and Kairos's financial scale.
notes: Entirely original to the Kairos Universe; not a real-world journalist.

Preserve his genuinely skeptical editorial voice in any future publication credited to him: he challenges Adrian Vale throughout the interview and does not retract his scrutiny of Asterion's scale, even after softening his headline.
